clinician.trajectory_summary: A 20-year-old female with T1DM presented with chronic nocturnal diarrhea, left lower quadrant pain, nausea, and lower extremity pains with numbness. Initial lab workup revealed a low total IgA. An upper endoscopy was performed and was grossly unremarkable, but gastric biopsies revealed a pattern consistent with autoimmune gastritis. Subsequent serum evaluation showed an elevated fasting gastrin level and an elevated parietal cell antibody level, without macrocytic anemia or vitamin B12 depletion. Celiac disease was excluded by upper endoscopy with small bowel biopsies, which did not show typical pathological patterns.
